problem_text:
A logistics company must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance checks at six distinct facilities.

The travel times between facilities, measured in minutes, are as follows:
* Facility Alpha to Bravo: 96.8 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Charlie: 65.9 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Delta: 109.9 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Echo: 84.1 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Foxtrot: 117.5 minutes
* Facility Bravo to Charlie: 137.0 minutes
* Facility Bravo to Delta: 108.3 minutes
* Facility Bravo to Echo: 109.6 minutes
* Facility Bravo to Foxtrot: 111.0 minutes
* Facility Charlie to Delta: 84.9 minutes
* Facility Charlie to Echo: 149.7 minutes
* Facility Charlie to Foxtrot: 92.6 minutes
* Facility Delta to Echo: 180.7 minutes
* Facility Delta to Foxtrot: 8.1 minutes
* Facility Echo to Foxtrot: 187.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, wherein the technician must visit every facility precisely once before concluding the tour back at the initial point of departure.
